purpose: Define one model-free, one-pass source of WAIT and exact-contract regret training targets without consulting the runtime composer or any model output.

independence_law.checker_rule: Every action-head target provenance trace must terminate in frozen labels, causal intent masks, fit-side CDFs, and frozen anchor thresholds without a composer-output or model-output ancestor.

population.unit: one governed flat decision minute t and its exact intent-eligible contracts c
population.intent_eligibility: Use only the canonical time-t intent masks from the referenced intent/fill-recheck law. A_(t+1), fill result, runtime-composer action, model forecast, and eventual selected identity are forbidden population filters.
population.minutes_with_zero_intent_eligible_contra: exclude from both WAIT and regret target populations and report the count
population.full_window_filter: Reuse objective_spec.json:/nested_empirical_cdf/full_window_filter exactly. A finite but censored near-close label is not a shorter full window and is excluded.
population.incomplete_required_label_set: If any intent-eligible contract lacks a required label for the registered anchor after the full-window filter, exclude that contract from regret targets; if this makes the label-auditable risk set incomplete for a minute, exclude that minute from the WAIT target and report the contract/minute/session denominators. Missingness is never converted to WAIT, ENTER, zero quality, or zero regret.
population.role_firewall: Build targets independently inside each inner training or disjoint calibration role. Outer validation, confirmation, protected holdout, live, and census-only rows never enter target thresholds or CDFs.

realized_label_transforms.nested_CDF_source: Fit-side, session-balanced empirical CDFs from objective_spec.json only; no scored or calibration row contributes to its own transform.

component_transform.dual_unit_arbitration: For a metric represented in dollars and return, take min(T_dollars,T_return) after both values are mapped in the same time-t premium band and market phase.

Q_label.within_horizon: Equal mean of non-timestamp registered transformed metrics after dual-unit arbitration.
Q_label.across_horizons: Equal mean over the causally available full-window horizons.
Q_label.quality_family_score: Apply those two equal means separately to early_drawdown, time_to_first_real_profit, pre_profit_adverse_excursion, underwater_burden, and profitable_window_stability.
Q_label.formula: Q_label(c,t)=mean(family_score_f(c,t) for the five registered quality families)

U_label.formula: U_label(c,t)=mean(u_h over all causally available registered full-window upside horizons)
U_label.relationship_to_Q: Q_label is the frozen five-family guardrail quantity and the first deterministic tie-break after U_label; it is not folded into U_label or given an invented weight.

realized_label_transforms.fee_cleared_upside: The equal-horizon realized MFE mean and realized profit-area mean must each be strictly greater than zero on both dollar and return axes. Equality, missingness, or nonfinite values fail the contract.

anchor_specific_RLAC.threshold_source: For each anchor alpha, use only the campaign anchor's training-side, label-derived nested quantile thresholds already registered by composer_spec.json:/stage_1_quality_screen. Alpha 0.0 applies no learned quality threshold.
anchor_specific_RLAC.guardrail_components: Exactly composer_spec.json:/stage_1_quality_screen/canonical_guardrail_components, evaluated on realized label transforms rather than forecasts.
anchor_specific_RLAC.guardrail_rule: For alpha>0, a contract passes only when every required realized quality component/unit clears its frozen training-side threshold in the registered favorable direction.
anchor_specific_RLAC.variant_isolation: Each registered alpha receives separately hashed RLAC verdicts, selected label identities, WAIT targets, and regret targets.
anchor_specific_RLAC.multiplicity: The anchor variants are already registered selectable members. RLAC creates no new variant, seed, or multiplicity member.

minute_verdict.contract_pass: intent eligible at t AND label complete under the full-window rule AND every active realized guardrail passes AND realized fee-cleared-upside passes
minute_verdict.ENTER_justified: At least one exact contract passes.

c_star_label.selection: argmax U_label(c,t) among passing exact contracts

c_star_regret_label.selection: argmax U_label(c,t) among every label-complete time-t intent-eligible contract, whether the minute verdict is ENTER or WAIT
c_star_regret_label.purpose: Define the all-population regret reference without changing the ENTER/WAIT verdict or choosing a runtime action.

WAIT_head.population: all label-auditable governed minutes with at least one time-t intent-eligible contract

regret_heads.population: all label-complete time-t intent-eligible contract-minute pairs (c,t), regardless of whether the runtime composer would select ENTER or select c
regret_heads.formula: regret_label(c,t)=U_label(c_star_regret_label(t),t)-U_label(c,t) on every included minute, including WAIT_justified minutes
regret_heads.exact_target_rule: Because c_star_regret_label is the deterministic full-population U_label argmax, the exact difference is nonnegative without clipping, shifting, or conditioning on a model/composer action.

coverage_scope.hard_conformal_claim: marginal over the complete RLAC regret target population: every label-complete intent-eligible contract on every included minute, including RLAC WAIT minutes
coverage_scope.runtime_composer_selected_subset: post-hoc conditional-coverage diagnostic only; no conditional guarantee is claimed
coverage_scope.selected_subset_collapse_route: owner_decision_required under the existing tripwire vocabulary

one_pass_order: join physically separate frozen FT2-04 labels in the training-only plane
build fit-only nested CDFs and anchor thresholds
compute Q_label and U_label directly from realized labels
emit anchor-specific RLAC minute verdicts and targets once
calibrate on disjoint blocks against independently built RLAC targets
required_artifacts: anchor-specific target rows keyed by session, decision minute, and exact contract identity
minute verdict, c_star_label, and c_star_regret_label trace
target-provenance DAG proving no model/composer ancestor
forbidden: constructing targets only on runtime-composer ENTER rows
using the runtime composer to select c_star_label
a provisional composer whose output changes target membership
future t+1 fill information in the time-t target population
zero-filling censored, missing, or inapplicable labels
